voters.comment: I know you didn’t follow the rules but appreciate the anarchy.

Normally I won’t upvote songs that ignore the category criteria. But this one was an honest mistake, and the song’s a banger. 

Also, categories that just have a particular word in the title are kinda lame and don’t lead to a thematic playlist.  So take my vote!
This is a catchy-ass song that I absolutely would have voted for, in a different universe where it fit the theme
Fun song, just slightly off topic 😊
